# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Zero-Trust Supply Chain — secure build & sign pipeline
# Author: Nour El Houda Bouajila (https://github.com/nourhb)
#
# Every image built here is:
#   1. Built with full SLSA provenance metadata (build service attestation)
#   2. Signed with Cosign in KEYLESS mode (Fulcio + Rekor via GitHub OIDC)
#   3. Attested with SLSA provenance + SBOM (Syft), both signed
#   4. Scanned with Trivy (fails the pipeline on CRITICAL vulnerabilities)
#
# The cluster (see kyverno/) verifies all of this at admission time.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

name: supply-chain

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]  # OIDC token for keyless Cosign signing (Fulcio) — no long-lived keys.
  id-token: write
  # Push images to GHCR and write attestations.
  contents: read
  packages: write
  # Upload Trivy SARIF results to code scanning.
  security-events: write
  # Write SLSA provenance attestations.
  attestations: write

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}/demo-app
  COSIGN_VERSION: v2.4.1
  SYFT_VERSION: v1.17.0

jobs:
  build-sign-attest:
    name: Build, sign & attest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    outputs:
      digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
      image: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3


permissions:
